items.difficulty_reason: Pushout lemma (statement 3300-3320, proof 3322-3343): verifies degree by degree that the attachment diagram is a pushout - low degrees clear, higher degrees via the degeneracy condition and induction on z', injectivity via the nondegenerate-simplex classification and the cited injectivity lemma; no verification is omitted. H2: elementary simplicial-set combinatorics.
